summary: Modern & Spacious 3-Bedroom Semi-Detached Home – Ideal for Families This beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached property offers modern living throughout, making it a perfect choice for families. The home boasts high-quality finishes and contemporary décor, creating a stylish and welcoming space. Downstairs features an impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area, ideal for entertaining or family mealtimes. The space is flooded with natural light and designed with both function and flair in mind. Upstairs, you’ll find three well-proportioned bedrooms, offering comfortable accommodation for families or those working from home. The property also benefits from a large rear garden – perfect for outdoor relaxation, children’s play, or summer gatherings. Located in a desirable area with convenient access to local amenities, schools, and transport links, this home is ready to move straight into.
